description: The line plot illustrates the performance of various pre-trained models on a multi-document summarization (MDS) task, measured by the Overall ROUGE-G Score (geometric mean of ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L), aggregated across six MDS benchmarks. The x-axis, labeled “# Training Examples,” is linear and spans values 0, 16, and 64, indicating the number of training examples used. The y-axis, labeled “Overall ROUGE-G Score,” is linear and ranges from 11.0 to 19.0, with tick marks at intervals of 2.0. Six models are compared: PELMS (solid green line with circle markers), PELMS (5%) (dashed green line with circle markers), Primera (solid red line with square markers), Primera (5%) (dashed red line with square markers), Pegasus-X (solid blue line with triangle markers), and Centrum (solid yellow line with diamond markers), along with their respective 5% adapter-tuned variants (dashed versions). PELMS consistently achieves the highest scores across all training example counts: starting at approximately 16.8 at 0 examples, rising to 18.7 at 16, and reaching 19.0 at 64. Its 5% variant follows closely, starting at 16.5, peaking at 17.5 at 16, and settling at 18.8 at 64. Primera begins at 15.0, increases to 17.0 at 16, and reaches 18.0 at 64; its 5% variant starts at 15.0, dips to 14.5 at 16, and recovers to 15.5 at 64. Pegasus-X starts at 13.5, dips to 11.5 at 16, and rises to 14.0 at 64; its 5% variant is not plotted. Centrum starts at 15.5, remains flat at 15.5 at 16, and increases slightly to 16.0 at 64; its 5% variant starts at 15.5, dips to 15.0 at 16, and returns to 15.5 at 64. Solid lines represent full fine-tuning, while dashed lines represent adapter training with only 5% of parameters tuned.
